main_text.p: nari, minitari. ܣܐܘܪ ܥܫܩ ܕܥܒܕܘ Impugnabat eum, Minabatur ei: Al. Insidiabatur ei, Marc.6.19.
ܐܬܦܥܠ Syr.Minæ, Act.9.1. Plur. ܐܬܦܥܠܘܢ Minæ eorum, Act.4.29.
לַחְמָא, לַחִים, לַחְמָם Ch. & Syr. Panis, cibus. Plural. לַחְמִין Panes.
לַחְמָם Ch. Convivium, Epulum, עֲבַר לַחְמָא Fecit convivium magnum, Dan.5.1.
לַחַן Chald. Concubina, pellex. Plural. לַחְנִין emph. לַחֲנָתָא Concubinæ.
לָחַשׁ Hebr. Mussitare, Submisse in aures loqui.
Hinc est Pahel Præt. Syr. ܐܬܠܚܫ Musf-sitaftis in aures, Luc.12.3. Part. Ch. מִלַּחֲשִׁין Mussitabant, 2. Samu.12.19. Significat præterea Hebræis Incantare. Hinc,
לַחֲשָׁא Ch. Incantatio. Plur.cum Aff. בְּלַחֲשֵׁיהוֹן Incantationibus suis, Exod.7.11.
לְחוּשׁ Ch. Fuscum, Genef.30.32. in T.Jon. & H.
לַחֵשׁ Ch.Ardens. Plur.fœm. גּוּמְרִין לַחְשָׁן Prunæ ardentes, Lev.16.12. Jon.
לְטָא Ch.Maledicere. Idem cum לוּט & לְטַט. Pahel לַטֵּי Idem.
לְטַט Ch.Idem. Pahel לַטֵּט Idem. Ithpah. אִתְלְטַט Maledici. Part. מִתְלַטְטִין Maledicti, Psal.37.22.
לְטַם לְטוּם Ch. Mastiche, Stacte. Variant interpretes. Respondet Hebr. לוּט, Gen.37.25.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in the scan with vowel points and diacritics; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are only approximately reproduced here and are uncertain. The line "Syr." forms and the lower-right catchword are doubtful. The line beginning "nari" carries Syriac script in the scan that could not be read letter by letter and is rendered approximately.
